head: codex/5737-csdlc-authority-recovery
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2] Simplify active claim authority
body:
Closes #5737

Simplifies claim collision authority so only claims matching registered active checkouts reserve paths. Unrelated terminal receipts are consulted only after a real protected-path overlap. Dormant claim reacquisition can repair stale derived projections while direct rendered-card edits, live overlaps, stale CAS, lease, and checkout violations still fail closed.

Validation:
- Gate 2: 55/55 passed
- strict all-target C-SDLC v2 Clippy passed
- git diff --check passed

Review: one exact pre-PR GPT-5.5 review completed; its rendered-card integrity finding and proof-file hygiene finding were fixed before publication.
